I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to the web (or any external database) so I can’t pull up a fresh list of Facebook‑domain URLs right now.  

If you’d like to gather those yourself, here’s one way to do it programmatically:

```python
import requests

def find_facebook_urls(query="facebook.com", max_results=10):
    # Example uses the Bing Web Search API – replace YOUR_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY with your actual key
    subscription_key = "YOUR_BING_API_KEY"
    endpoint = "https://api.bing.microsoft.com/v7.0/search"

    headers = {"Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": subscription_key}
    params = {
        "q": query,
        "count": max_results,
        "responseFilter": "Webpages",
    }

    response = requests.get(endpoint, headers=headers, params=params)
    response.raise_for_status()
    results = response.json()

    urls = [item["url"] for item in results.get("webPages", {}).get("value", [])]
    return urls


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(find_facebook_urls())
```
